title: Illustration vs. Photography
slide_intent: Choose a medium according to the thing a reader needs to understand. A financial story can be symbolic, while a food image relies on recognizable texture.
strategic_value: Instacart can use illustration to explain shopping benefits and photography to make a dish appealing.
demonstration: Two equally sized panels show an illustrated phone with money and chart marks beside a close photograph of plated food. Both carry a green check and a different use caption.
practical_value: Ask whether the message depends on an abstract relationship or on the sensory qualities of a real dish, then select the corresponding medium.

content_islands.name: Selection rule
content_islands.spec: Place the brief in the left column and keep its concluding food-photography rule prominent.

content_islands.name: Illustrated story
content_islands.spec: Center the phone and financial symbols on a pale square and attach the caption about stories that photography cannot depict.

content_islands.name: Food photograph
content_islands.spec: Place a detail of the finished dish in a matching frame and attach the caption describing its appetizing qualities.
